tagline: Offline screenshots, annotation and screen recording — region/window/monitor capture, arrows to blur to numbered steps, MP4/GIF recording.
description: Capture, mark up and record your screen without anything leaving your machine. Screen Studio 1.1 puts the everyday flow first: grab a dragged region (Ctrl+N), the full screen, one monitor or the active window, and the shot opens straight in Annotate — arrow, box, ellipse, line, text, highlight, blur, crop and auto-numbered steps, with undo, one-click Copy and Save. Record the full screen or a region to MP4 or GIF at your chosen frame rate (via FFmpeg), with a live elapsed timer. A Recent list re-opens anything you saved, and Settings (Ctrl+,) offers the System/Light/Dark theme choice — the app follows the OS Aura theme live by default. Fully offline: captures and recordings stay on this device, nothing is ever uploaded.
